title: RC Smart
description: Dynamically create & delete server, with ANY provider, and the magic of RustyConnector
body:
![Rusty Smart Banner](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/democraftmc/rcm-smart/refs/heads/main/blob/images/banner.png)
# 🧠 Rusty Smart Module > Dynamically create & delete servers, with ANY provider, and the magic of RustyConnector! RC Smart allows you to implement *horizontal scaling* to **any** Minecraft network. Cut costs and give better performance to your players by only hosting the servers they play on. Additionally, Smart uses an *abstract* technology layer — meaning it can be integrated with virtually **any cloud provider**! --- ## 🚀 Introduction The goal of Smart is to be a flexible and modular cloud system. Like any cloud system, Smart brings these three key features: - ⚖️ **Load Balancing** per server groups (“families”) → handled by *RustyConnector* - 🧩 **Dynamic Server Creation** — create servers when needed - 🧹 **Smart Cleanup** — delete them when they’re not used --- ## 🧱 Installation 1. Drop the module’s `.jar` file inside the `rc-modules` folder of your Minecraft Proxy. 2. Restart the RustyConnector kernel. 3. Let the magic happen ✨ For detailed setup instructions, see our [official documentation](https://smart.democraft.fr/docs/smart/). --- ## ☁️ Providers Smart needs at least one [provider](https://smart.democraft.fr/docs/providers/) to work. A **provider** acts as an adapter between Smart and your infrastructure. ### 🦖 [Pterodactyl Provider](https://modrinth.com/plugin/rcs-pterodactyl) Use the **Pterodactyl Panel API** to dynamically scale your Minecraft network! --- ## 💬 Questions? Need help? Check out the [documentation](https://smart.democraft.fr/docs/smart/) for more information. You can also contact [Smart’s Support](https://dsc.gg/drmcld) on Discord!
